waiting: Python is still starting. Cells run when it is ready.
updated: The page now shows the chapter's new version.
kept: The page now shows the chapter's new version. Your saved copy, with your changes, is kept as {copy}.
loading: Loading Python in your browser. You can keep reading and writing exercise answers.
preparing: Python has started. Preparing the chapter.
slow: The first load can take longer, especially on a slow connection.
stalled: Still waiting for Python to be ready. You can wait or retry. Retry restarts Python without reloading the page and keeps your answers and notebook edits.
failed: Could not start Python. Retry keeps your answers and notebook edits.
runFailed: Could not finish running the cells. Try running them again.
